daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot today, Pisces. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your spiritual GPS right now. The vibe is introspective but in a generative way, like you're processing stuff that actually matters.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, today's about showing up authentically rather than performing. Single? Someone's noticing your energy. Either way, vulnerability is your superpower rn. Let people see the real you.
daily.career: Your creative solutions are gold today. Don't second-guess your ideas—that imaginative brain of yours has something the room needs. This is your moment to pitch, propose, or just make your presence known.
daily.health: Your nervous system might feel a lil overstimulated, so create space for rest without guilt. Whether that's a walk, some music, or just existing quietly—honor what your body's asking for. You're allowed to refill your cup.

weekly.overview: Mercury's moving through your zone of self-expression, Pisces. This week invites you to speak your truth without apologizing. Trust the quiet knowing that's been building inside you—it's been trying to get your attention.
weekly.love: Venus is asking you to be vulnerable in a way that feels scary but necessary. Whether you're single or coupled, authentic connection thrives when you show up as yourself. Let someone see the real you this week.
weekly.career: Your creative energy is high, and people are noticing. This is the moment to share that idea you've been sitting on or take that small risk you've been considering. Your intuition about timing is spot-on right now.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness, not intensity. Move in ways that feel good rather than punishing. Pay attention to what actually energizes you versus what you think should. Rest is productive.
